dayLines:
Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.
Something moves out there — Drum-Belly.
You catch fragments by the fire — Imani telling Ivy about Brianna. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Nikos telling Ivy about Hayden. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.
It followed you. The Drum-Belly is here.
📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Living Wire is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Movement — a wild turkey, iridescent feathers.
👁 Spook the flock and one might lag behind. Watch for the straggler.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.
It followed you. The Drum-Belly is here.
Movement — a waddling opossum, playing dead (badly).
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 11 people, 9 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 3 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Fallen trunks lie like sleeping animals, furred with moss. The ground gives underfoot — centuries of leaf-mold.
Movement — a waddling opossum, playing dead (badly).
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.
Stonebridge's clearing. Voices, a cookfire, somebody else's home. You're a guest here — act like it.
A fallen tree blocks the path.
A fallen tree blocks the path.
A fallen tree blocks the path.
Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
Something pads into the clearing — Drum-Belly. It's here.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Deep shade. The floor keeps its secrets.
You work the patch: 6× Hickory Nuts — and 13× unknown shoots you can't name yet. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
A fallen tree blocks the path.

Maja leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Living Wire. Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Get OUT of the water — When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek.
✨ Ability gained: Lucky Rock (L1). Your lucky rock. The System finds your faith adorable and helps a little: +5% on the hunt. (It’s not the rock. It’s you believing in the rock.)
"The rock! It is lucky! We checked! It's... a rock! But YOU believe! Belief is power! (We added 4%.)"
"Earned, not given. You did the work — we just wrote it down."
Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
Movement — a black bear, powerful and intelligent-eyed.
👁 It's not scared — it's DECIDING. Two hundred pounds of deciding. Give it the exit, never the corner; noise and bigness buy you the day.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
Something moves out there — Drum-Belly.
Wanjiru speaks only 🇰🇪 Swahili. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
💡 You're starting to catch words in Swahili. Not sentences — words.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.
Movement — a bobcat, tufted ears, watching you with yellow eyes.
👁 It is hunting you. Don't run — that invites the chase. Hold your ground, strike true, or wear the claws.
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
Journal: Deep shade. The floor keeps its secrets.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 8× Hickory Nuts (in shell — shell them to eat). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Wanjiru speaks only 🇰🇪 Swahili. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
Late, quiet, Wanjiru tells you: "Their peoples have history — the plains communes and the city wards. The kind measured in generations, not arguments."
Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Go for the eyes — When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus.
You catch fragments by the fire — Hayden telling Nathan about Imani. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — Hayden telling Werner about Imani. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
Travel 2 tiles to Haven.
Haven. 4 days. The palisade looks smaller than you remembered, or you got bigger. Somebody by the fire: "Knew you'd walk back in. You always do."
While you were gone — 8 things you missed:
⚔️ Werner killed the Living Wire alone — 3 rounds, 26 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
💧 The cistern's recovered — full cups again, and nobody's guarding the dipper.
⚔️ Werner stood down the Anaconda Empress and kept walking — 4 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Hayden stared down the Drum-Belly and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Wanjiru stared down the Drum-Belly and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
...and 3 more. Ask around — they'll tell you.
You start in on Tea Bush too — and they grin. "Old news, friend. Imani showed us that one." Still: you carried it home. That's the job.
2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
You lay out the haul. Wanjiru leans over Hickory Nuts. "Oh — THAT one. Here, look."
📖 Wanjiru starts in on the lesson, then catches themself. "Hold on — I already showed you this one. Hickory Nuts. You remember."
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 1L carried (1kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 20L left.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Travel 1 tile to grove.
★ Deeper knowledge: Hickory Nuts. Parts: nut meat (eat), shells (smoke flavor), bark (tea). Crack carefully. (Yield +50%). Use unlocked: food: sweet nutmeats — shell first, worth the work.
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
You work the patch with practiced hands: 5× Muscadine Grapes, 8× Hickory Nuts, 7× White Oak Acorns (450 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You keep a day's food (450 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.

You walk back into Haven. 14 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
📋 Wanjiru — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Imani — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Werner — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
Imani doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
Imani plants themself in front of you. "This isn't working. You know it, I know it. Say it out loud."
Brianna hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
📋 Hayden — 🍲 Cook. They'll report back by next part.
Imani mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
You eat Muscadine Grapes (450 kcal).
Walking 5 squares (10 kcal)…
You step into the Haven hall.
